**Summary**

[FX-2748](https://algolia.atlassian.net/browse/FX-2748)

**Result**

All existing tests pass for both vue2 and vue3.

Had to get rid of the Vue3 example I made because of CodeSandbox running Node 16, but we can make one later when CodeSandbox's version is updated.

As components are different for Vue2 and Vue3, I organized the code so that once we remove support for Vue2 we won't have any changes to do to the Highlighter component, which is why it doesn't import from `vue-compat`.
